codeReview.summary: The fix commit correctly adds note tokens in `theme.ts`, switches dark M3 `onBackground`/`onSurface` to `#E8E4DE`, sets StatsCard's icon circle to 10px, and updates Android tab labels to weight 600. However, it does not fully resolve the prior scrutiny failures: note-related UI still has legacy hardcoded colors outside the theme layer, and the bottom navigation still exposes the old tab IA instead of the requested Home/Farms/Logs/AI/More set.

issues.description: The note palette issue is only partially fixed. `src/styles/theme.ts` now defines `note`/`observation` as `#5C6D91`/`#7A8DAA`, but `LOG_TYPES` still hardcodes the legacy note color `#738c7a`. That metadata is consumed by `src/components/screens/entry-form.tsx:71`, `src/components/screens/entry-form/PendingLogs.tsx:1`, `src/components/cards/activity-log-card.tsx:115`, and `src/components/cards/timeline-log-card.tsx:177`, so note-related UI still does not consistently resolve through the required blue note palette. `src/types/task.ts:98` also still hardcodes `#738c7a` for note tasks.

The Android active-label weight is now `600`, but the visible tabs still render the old IA (`tabs.dashboard`, `tabs.explore`, `tabs.workers`, `tabs.tools`, `tabs.aiAssistant`) instead of the requested `Home`, `Farms`, `Logs`, `AI`, `More` set. The same mismatch remains in the iOS `NativeTabs` triggers at lines 236-299, so the original tab-set blocking issue from `update-tab-bar` is still unresolved.

summary: Fail: the fix clears the dark M3 text mapping, StatsCard radius, and Android font-weight issues, but note-related UI still contains legacy hardcoded colors and the bottom nav still does not implement the requested Home/Farms/Logs/AI/More tab set. No new regressions were found in the touched files beyond these still-unresolved requirements.
